narrative:
Williams County has 24,324 registered voters, with 55.0% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 35.8% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 9.2%, a pronounced Republican lean of 26.6 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.4% of registrants.
